svg.title: Player 1 character sheet: Yunus, full-stack and cloud engineer
svg.desc: A photo of Yunus next to an RPG character sheet. Class: full-stack and cloud engineer. Party: Claude, build partner. Inventory: Yunus OS (JavaScript, MIT), dwago (Python, Apache-2.0), capture-check (Python, MIT) and Hushfall (in development). Playstyle: I direct the design and playtesting. Claude helps me build and iterate. I share the code, demos and decisions. Status: shipping in public. The red-hooded hero from his game rests at a campfire on the portrait frame; when a code beetle peeks over the edge he defeats it and it drops a gold coin.

text.tspan: I DIRECT THE DESIGN AND PLAYTESTING.
CLAUDE HELPS ME BUILD AND ITERATE.
I SHARE THE CODE, DEMOS AND DECISIONS.
